name: hire-the-fire
description: MERN job portal: seekers apply, recruiters run a hiring pipeline, admins moderate.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c red,yellow "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"

scripts.test: npm test -w server && npm test -w client
